## KultrDL 1.1.1

**Suggestions now learn from the Navidrome account you listen with.**

Navidrome keeps plays, stars and ratings per account. If KultrDL was signed in as an admin while you listen in another app (like Kultr) with your own account, it read the admin's history, not yours.

- **Sign in with your own account.** Settings → Recommendations → Navidrome. Switch to the account you listen with and save. If the account before was an admin, KultrDL keeps that admin login, but only for starting rescans after downloads (only admins can start them). Everything else, like reading your plays and streaming, uses your own account.
- **It tells you.** When you're signed in as an admin, the Navidrome page suggests switching, and *Test connection* says whether the account is an admin.
- **Admin login for rescans.** If your own account was set up from the start, add an admin login under *Download to Navidrome*, or leave it out: Navidrome then finds new files on its own schedule. Like every password in KultrDL, it's kept in the iOS Keychain.
- After reading the server, the page shows how many songs your account has played.

The same as KultrDL for Android 1.2.1; backups still move between the two.

## Install

Download **KultrDL.ipa** below and install it with **Sideloadly** (Windows, Mac), **AltStore** (Windows, Mac) or **Impactor** (Linux) — or with no computer at all, through **SideStore**. It installs over earlier versions and keeps your library. New to this? Follow the step-by-step guide: https://github.com/evropiani/KultrDL_iOS/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md

Or add the source `https://gist.githubusercontent.com/evropiani/6e3a3c18525a228d03924674430c4d48/raw/evropiani.json` to AltStore or SideStore, and new versions arrive as updates.
